Let's calculate ${log}_{8}⁡(19)$ by changing the base $8$ to the common logarithm (base $10$).

We use the change of base formula:

$$
{log}_{a}⁡X=\frac{{log}_{b}⁡X}{{log}_{b}⁡a}
$$

In our case, $a=8,$ $X=19,$ $b=10.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{8}⁡(19) & =\frac{{log}_{10}⁡(19)}{{log}_{10}⁡(8)} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{log}⁡(19)}{\operatorname{log}⁡(8)} \\  & ≈\frac{1.278\,754}{0.903\,090} \\  & ≈1.416\end{aligned}
$$
